purpose: The ready-made GilbPlatform host for the Stakeholder entry card: one provider that sets the platform's origins and the session and supplies every host the online stakeholder card needs, so it draws, reads and adds with no host object written.
namedChanges: src/inline.ts holds the inline copies, each token-equal to the declaration it cites: `HELD_RECORD_FRESH_MS` (recordHooks.ts 449), `heldRecordOf` (456-462), `useRecordsBeingDeleted` (2609-2630), `createdInVaultKey` and `rememberCreatedIn` (2836-2845), `placeClaimsKey` and `PLACE_CLAIMS_STALE_MS` (usePlaceClaims.ts 50-52). Their free names are the units' exports of the same names (`vaultOriginOf` of `vault-origin-rule`, `watchRecordDeletes` of `plan-record-hooks`, `deletedLinkedRecords`, `deletedLinkedRevision` and `onDeletedLinkedRecords` of `stakeholder-list-state`).

src/inline.ts `createIsGeoEntityId(geoOrigin)` is `isGeoEntityId` (baseGeo.ts 82-84) over the prefix `<geoOrigin without trailing slashes>/base/e/` (baseGeo.ts 61-64), the origin a provider prop where the app's was a constant built from the GilbGeo vault id.

src/adderCard.ts holds `adderCardOf` whole (adderCard.ts 98-110) with `NO_OWN_VAULT_SAYS`, `NoOwnVaultError`, `landingVaultOf`, `nameFromEmail`, `making`, `readFinding` and `findOrMake` (68-88): each is token-equal to the source's (measured with the census tool: 22, 38, 118, 53, 160 and 174 tokens). The make half is the units': `ensureVaultSelfCard` and `vaultRootOf` of `vault-profile-photo`, `readRecord` of `lws-records`, `vaultLabel` of `vault-list`. 0.2.0 removes `NO_OWN_CARD_SAYS` (0.1.0 refused with it where the source made the card).

src/photoTerm.ts is `photoTerm` and `photoReadKeysSync` (photoTerm.ts 19-22, 74-76) with `vedaOrigin` the provider's `origin` (the app's `BASE_ORIGIN`), one resolver per origin, and `store` the device's `localStorage` when there is one. 0.2.0 adds `photoReadKeysOf(resolver)`, the app's `photoReadKeys` (37-41) over that resolver: one ask shared for 60 s (`PHOTO_TERM_RETRY_MS`, 32), a failed resolve answering the last answer that worked, else none with the source's warning (`askPhotoReadKeys`, 48-64). Left out: `tellIfKeysChanged` (the app's subscription for its sync readers; this unit's sync read is `peek()`). One function per resolver, so the header, the Employees group and the card share one ask as the app's module did.

src/defaults.ts holds the values a member takes when the developer gives none: no held-note line, no place claims, and for `useContactLabels` the value of the source's hook in its disabled branch (useContactLabels.ts 256-258, read, not run). Since 0.2.0 the three photo members default to the units': `discoverVaultProfilePhoto` and `loadPhotoObjectUrl` of `vault-profile-photo` (the first over a host with the photo term's read keys; `noteVaultPicture` left absent) and `loadGranteeFace` of `grantee-face`.

src/shell.ts builds the shell the card reads (`useShell`, ShellContext.ts 412) from the credential's session and the `useVaults` of `reachable-vaults` (the vault set of hooks.ts 108-129); `contentScope` is `{ readVaultId, reach: null }`.
src/provider.tsx takes the query client's defaults from main.tsx 72-76.
every other member is a function a unit exports (`masterKindReader` and `useRelations` of `plan-stakeholder-io`), a prop of the provider, or `() => 0` (`requestsSent`, requestMeter.ts 39).

test/ holds the master and platform fixtures of `person-create` (`support.ts`, `fixtureReference.ts`, `fixtureTag.ts`, `fixturePlatform.ts`, `writableFields.ts`), copied unchanged; they are not shipped as source (`files` lists `test`, as the Plan-card provider's does).

0.2.0 hosts the standalone Org units. src/hosts/ gains `createCardReferencesHost` (`changeRecordFactItems` of `record-fact-items`), `createOrgMarkHost` (`downloadFileOutcome` of `file-download-outcome`), `createOrgEmployeesHost` (`readResources` inline, `useSheetHistory` and `dropStaleSheetEntry` of `sheet-history`, the photo keys, and `RecordFace` when given) and `createPickerQuery` (`usePickerQuery`, inline). The provider mounts `OrgEmployeesHostContext`, `OrgMarkHostContext` and `PickerQueryContext` (which `org-hierarchy` reads); the `card-references` host is a factory, as the unit takes it as an argument.

src/inline.ts gains `usePickerQuery` (the five options of OrgRecordPicker.tsx 144-150), `getResource` (lws.ts 57-71, with `resourceOf` inlined and the etag, which nothing here reads, left out; not token-equal) and `readResources` (lws.ts 164-170, token-equal, 90 tokens) over `mapWithConcurrency` and `MAX_PARALLEL_DEREFERENCES` of `lws-vault-sets`, `idFromResourceUri` of `resource-id` and `entityUriInVault` of `vault-namespace`.

0.3.1: package metadata only (no source or test change): `held-notes` and the units of its peer tree are added to `devDependencies`, and the lockfile is refreshed, because `org-employees` 0.2.1 imports `subjectSpellings` and `inVault` from `held-notes`.
